dedupe_keys.name: rufas ruminant farm systems whole farm dairy simulation model

description: An open-source whole-farm simulation model for dairy farms. The JDS Communications review (30 October 2025) says RuFaS is a modular platform that integrates animal, manure, soil and crop, and feed storage modules to evaluate management strategies, environmental interventions and productivity, supports scenario and uncertainty analysis, is used in the FARM Environmental Stewardship programme for greenhouse gas accounting, and is developed openly on GitHub under the GPLv3 licence, free to download. Coverage is dairy farms. Caveats: the review does not give validation statistics in its abstract. For simulation it models a dairy farm's feed, animals and manure together, to test how feed shortages, heat or disrupted milk collection would affect production. A related catalogue record is the EPA AgSTAR livestock anaerobic digester database.
